name: StrollPlace – Neighborhood Widgets for Real Estate
author: strollplace

sections.description:
Help buyers explore the area while they browse your real estate site. Add area
overviews, schools, walkability, commute information, local places, and
optional citywide reported crime data to supported U.S. listings and guides.

Free to embed without a StrollPlace account or MLS/IDX credentials. Enable the
external service in WordPress to get started.

What buyers see

  • Area overview — a short introduction to the city or neighborhood.
  • Key metrics — a snapshot of local indicators where available.
  • Schools — nearby schools, with grade levels where available.
  • Places to explore — parks, libraries, recreation centers, and other local
    spots.
  • Getting around — optional walkability and commute information.
  • Reported crime — optional citywide reported crime data.

Coverage is for U.S. locations. Each section appears when data is available.

Two ways to use StrollPlace

  • Automatic listing enrichment. Add area information to supported property
    details, search grids, and lightboxes. StrollPlace reads the location from
    the page without changing theme or IDX files.
  • Reusable place cards. Save a named city or neighborhood card, then use the
    StrollPlace block or [strollplace id="SAVED-UUID"] in guides, posts, or
    landing pages. Edit the saved card to update every placement.

Supported real estate themes & IDX plugins

  • Houzez: classic, tabbed, full-width, and Elementor layouts for property
    details and listing grids.
  • IDX and listing platforms: IDX Broker, Showcase IDX, iHomefinder
    (legacy and v10 open shadow roots), Realtyna WPL, Real Geeks, Lofty
    (WordPress templates), Flexmls (WordPress), SimplyRETS (WordPress),
    dsIDXpress, Buying Buddy, Rover IDX, RealScout (search results with
    disable-shadow-dom), AgentFire (native AF IDX), CloseDaily, and EAP.
  • Other sites: Auto detects supported markup, including public
    Schema.org RealEstateListing. A custom container controls placement.

Listings must expose a U.S. city and state. Closed shadow roots and
cross-origin iframes are inaccessible from the outer page. Houzez quick views
and map popups are unsupported. StrollPlace is an independent integration.

Built to match your site

Choose a preset or set a light, dark, or visitor-preference color scheme.
Adjust the accent, background, text color, font, and border radius. In
StrollPlace > Listing pages, use Preview a listing to see what’s nearby
for a U.S. city and state, property coordinates, or the built-in Mar Vista
example.

External service

This plugin loads executable JavaScript and styles from
widgets.strollplace.com to render the shared
StrollPlace runtime. The immutable bootstrap is integrity checked. It selects
a compatible v1 runtime that StrollPlace updates automatically. The integrity
check pins the bootstrap bytes only. PHP executes no remote code.

A WordPress plugin manager must explicitly enable the service before
editor/admin place search, previews, or visitor requests can run. Editor/admin
search sends the entered place query. Listing previews send the preview city,
state, or coordinates. Visitor requests send the selected place ID or the
detected listing city and state, plus coordinates where the shared adapter
supports them. Requests expose normal browser connection metadata such
as IP address. Requests omit credentials. The service collects no StrollPlace
login or MLS/IDX API keys from this plugin.

Widgets include StrollPlace branding and source links. Review your site’s
privacy disclosure before enabling. See the StrollPlace
Terms of Service and
Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. In Plugins > Add New, find StrollPlace, install and activate it,
    or use Upload Plugin with the ZIP.
  2. In StrollPlace > Overview, review and enable the external service.
  3. In Listing pages, leave Auto mode on, choose a provider or automatic
    detection, and check a listing. For individually placed listing widgets,
    choose Manual mode.
  4. For a place card, go to Shortcodes > Add new, choose a place, and save.
    Select the saved name in the StrollPlace block or paste the copied
    shortcode into a Shortcode block.

Users who can activate plugins manage consent, settings, and saved cards.
Trash hides existing placements, restore brings them back, and copy creates
an independent configuration.

The plugin ships readable PHP and JavaScript plus original SCSS, shared
TypeScript, and build tools in source/. WordPress needs no build step.
sections.faq:
Is StrollPlace free to use? Do I need an account?

It’s free to embed without a StrollPlace account. A plugin manager enables
the service in StrollPlace > Overview.

Do I need an IDX feed or an MLS API key?

No. StrollPlace reads the location shown on supported listing pages. Your
existing theme or IDX provider continues to display and manage your listings.

Does activation contact StrollPlace?

No. Editor/admin searches, previews, and visitor requests are disabled until a
plugin manager enables the service.

Which real estate themes and IDX plugins are supported?

See the provider list above. Verify custom templates. For a separately hosted
IDX document, install inside that document where the provider permits it.

Is this an official integration with the IDX providers?

StrollPlace adapters read public listing markup. Providers are listed for
compatibility only.

Which locations are covered?

U.S. cities and neighborhoods where StrollPlace has data. Sections with
unavailable data are hidden automatically.

Can I customize the design to match my theme?

Yes. Save your style and section choices in a reusable configuration.

Will it slow down my site or conflict with my theme CSS?

The loader uses wp_footer, styles are isolated in Shadow DOM, and admin
assets stay in WordPress admin. The widget stays empty if delivery is blocked
or data is missing. With dynamic navigation, preserve the runtime or execute
WordPress-rendered embed scripts.

Which shortcodes can I use?

Use [strollplace id="SAVED-UUID"] with the ID from a saved configuration.
Legacy blocks and direct shortcodes also work:

  • [strollplace place_type="city" place_id="UUID-FROM-PLACE-SEARCH"]
  • [strollplace mode="listing"]
  • [strollplace mode="container" container="strollplace-listing-context"]

Can I cache pages or use CSP?

Yes. Purge HTML caches after changing settings. Preserve script data
attributes, integrity, and crossorigin. Keep the remote widget scripts
out of script-combining and rewriting tools. Hash or origin CSP modes work
with full-page caching. Nonce mode requires a fresh nonce shared by the CSP
header and HTML for each response, or a full-page cache bypass.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, with network or per-site activation as allowed by network policy.
Consent, saved shortcodes, and settings are per site. New sites start in Auto mode with the
service disabled until a site plugin manager enables it. Super administrators
retain normal access. Activation performs no network-wide scan or writes.

How do I completely remove plugin settings on uninstall?

Settings persist through deactivation and uninstall. For permanent removal,
delete the strollplace_settings and strollplace_shortcodes options on each
site that used the plugin.
sections.changelog:
0.1.4

  • Add style presets to the WordPress widget configurator.
  • Clarify widget attribution, setup instructions, and preview messages.

0.1.3

  • Add optional Getting around and Reported crime sections to place cards and
    listing widgets, and show grade levels on supported school results.
  • Preview What’s Nearby using a U.S. city and state, property coordinates, or a
    built-in Mar Vista example.
  • Clarify setup instructions and add examples to the WordPress.org listing.

0.1.2

  • Add Houzez and CloseDaily provider selections with detail/search placements.
  • Improve configurator search validation, request reuse and offscreen previews.
  • Refresh bundled assets when their contents change, even if timestamps match.
  • Preserve multilingual saved names and keep trashed configurations hidden when
    saving an older edit form.

0.1.1

  • Make settings sanitization explicit for every field and use WordPress color
    sanitization. Clarify footer delivery and default Auto mode documentation.

0.1.0

  • Initial place card block and shortcode, provider-aware listing enrichment,
    explicit service opt-in, appearance settings and immutable bootstrap support.
